next_step: Complete 2-week POC (streaming + tool-calling) and run latency SLO tests; pricing follow-up w/ commercial
notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood for outbound SDR/chat agents and in-product assistants. Primary objective: low-latency streaming chat with tool-calling to CRM/email/calendar.

POC scope: 2-week POC on Hosted API -> performance test for 95th/99th latency under realistic concurrency (50-200 concurrent agents). Demo included streaming (SSE) + tool-calling flow: update SFDC lead, enqueue email, create calendar invite. Must validate function/tool security & webhook reliability.

Technical requirements / quotes from calls: 
- Wants P95 end-to-end token streaming latency <= 150ms under demo load (short turns ~40-120 tokens).
- Tool calling must be able to run idempotent CRM updates and return structured success/failure quickly.
- Need server-side SSE or websocket stream (client expects incremental tokens). "It needs to feel instant to reps."
- Preference to start on Hosted for speed; plan to migrate to Dedicated if unit economics and SLA match. 
- Model preferences: OK with open LLM (large decoder) plus smaller fallbacks for bulk outbound. Interested in quantization options to reduce cost.
- Data controls: SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration, retention controls; EU data residency for some customers.

Commercial/Procurement: Mid-market seat-based ARR target $50-150k. Pricing sensitivity around per-concurrent-agent burst cost. Wants visibility into token-level costs per route and batching recommendations.

Quotes / snippets: 
- AE: "If streaming feels slow the SDRs won't adopt it. Latency >200ms feels clunky."
- Head of RevOps: "We need an audit trail for any automated CRM write - can't lose attribution."

Integration notes:
- CRM: Salesforce primary; need connector patterns and idempotency guidance.
- Email: Send via ESP webhook with retry/backoff.
- Calendar: Generate invites and return link to agent.

POC deliverables (agreed):
- Hosted POC env + walkthrough (Alex, Maria, Eng lead).
- Latency SLO report (P95/P99) after synthetic + replay traffic.
- Tool-calling reliability report (success/failure distribution).
- Light pricing estimate for Dedicated migration.

Open questions:
- Detailed commitment levels for Dedicated pricing tiers.
- Clarify residency options for EU subset.
- How persistent KV cache will behave across Dedicated nodes for conversation continuity.
